documents.entry: AI Personal Assistants Market Watch/AI Personal Assistants Market Watch.md
documents.name: AI Personal Assistants Market Watch
documents.summary: Follow the assistant market through sourced signals, comparisons and research decisions.
documents.title: AI Personal Assistants Market Watch
documents.excerpt: Eight selected products and twelve dated primary-source cards give this example a research cohort. Compare the signals, keep publisher-described capabilities distinct from hands-on findings, and decide what merits attention.

documents.name: Business Review
documents.summary: Quarterly close, operating review and a decision pack from your own numbers.
documents.title: Business Review
documents.excerpt: The fictional full-year review reports $19.2M of revenue. Changing Q4 revenue from 5.7 to 6.0 raises the calculated annual total to $19.5M; the authored conclusions still need review.
headings: Growth is healthy; the next decision is how to sustain it

documents.name: Charts Gallery
documents.summary: Every chart and diagram Flow draws, driven from an editable table you own.
documents.title: Charts Gallery
documents.excerpt: An editable four-row table drives a bar chart and a donut. Browse 34 chart forms and 20 Mermaid forms, with fictional teaching data and notes on reading each visual honestly.

documents.name: Competitor Watch
documents.summary: Dated competitor observations, refreshed evidence and changes worth reviewing.
documents.title: Competitor Watch
documents.excerpt: Keep dated competitor observations beside the decisions they inform. Named public sources can be refreshed; a changed source gives you something to investigate, without deciding the response for you.

documents.name: Customer Research
documents.summary: Interview coding, observations and the research questions they answer.
documents.title: Research Brief
documents.excerpt: The fictional study codes eleven interviews. Add a twelfth interview with Portable files as its need: the calculated count becomes four. The small, biased sample does not estimate market prevalence.
headings: Approval records are the leading coded need, within a small biased sample
What to do with the finding

documents.name: Flow Handbook
documents.summary: How Flow's tools, Jobs and the Night Shift work, page by page.
documents.title: Using Flow
documents.excerpt: Ordinary text, tables, links and images remain readable in other editors. Flow’s chart, Mermaid and living-data blocks stay in the Markdown file; other readers may show their source.
headings: Read, work and keep the result

documents.name: Health Evidence
documents.summary: Aggregate service counts and an operational evidence review.
documents.title: Health Evidence
documents.excerpt: Compare missed-appointment counts with their denominators in a fictional operational review. A downward series does not establish that a change to reminder wording caused the result.
headings: Did the latest week change the question?
Read the rate alongside the count
Pool the underlying appointments, not the percentages

documents.name: Household Budget
documents.summary: Turn your spending inputs into current totals and a useful monthly review.
documents.title: Household Budget
documents.excerpt: Two fictional statements contain 79 rows. The example keeps uncategorized spending visible and distinguishes a cash-flow surplus from a transfer to savings. It is a dated sample, not a bank connection.

documents.name: Insurance Renewal
documents.summary: Renewal packet, quotation changes and the questions for your broker.
documents.title: Insurance Renewal
documents.excerpt: A fictional design studio keeps expiring premiums, quotations and missing documents together. A pending quote is not zero, and two prices do not establish equivalent protection.
headings: Compare the quoted prices without hiding the gap
Bring three questions to the broker

documents.name: Investment Research
documents.summary: Management claims, missing evidence and the diligence questions that remain.
documents.title: Diligence Brief
documents.excerpt: The fictional Larkspur Robotics memo asks whether sales can succeed beyond the CEO. Management claims, missing operating evidence and the next diligence questions remain separate.
headings: Sales transferability is the first question to investigate
The memo is an argument to test

documents.name: Job Search
documents.summary: Applications, next actions and evidence-based tailoring.
documents.title: Job Search
documents.excerpt: A fictional offer deadline falls before another interview. The tracker keeps both dates visible, alongside missing written terms and the resume used. No application or message is sent by this example.

documents.name: Legal Matter
documents.summary: A factual chronology, a source index and the evidence still missing.
documents.title: Legal Matter
documents.excerpt: The fictional file contains arrival counts of fifty-five and sixty cartons. Preserve both with their source records until they are reconciled. The chronology prepares factual review; it does not settle the dispute.
headings: Read the chronology, then the records
The evidence does not yet answer the central question

documents.name: Living Document Starter
documents.summary: Your own small recurring project, with the smallest useful Jobs.
documents.title: Living Document
documents.excerpt: A fictional onboarding plan allocates 400 of 500 available minutes across three items. Bound views follow changes to the plan and source note; the surrounding written assessment stays yours to revise.
headings: Work that earns its place in the plan

documents.name: Marketing Campaign
documents.summary: Editorial calendar, campaign review and a draft announcement in one desk.
documents.title: Campaign Desk
documents.excerpt: A fictional October plan alternates two essays with two working notes. The customer-workflow essay still needs evidence before becoming a credible draft. An editorial calendar does not publish the pieces.
headings: Four useful pieces; one still needs its evidence
Give each piece a different purpose

documents.name: Model Arena
documents.summary: Published model comparisons and a record of your own evaluation.
documents.title: Model Arena
documents.excerpt: Dated recommendations and measurements sit together. Compare warm generation speed under its stated conditions; speed is not answer quality. Editing this copy does not change Flow’s runtime recommendations.

documents.name: NVIDIA Company Research
documents.summary: Understand one company through three sections, three sources and a focused research question.
documents.title: NVIDIA Company Research
documents.excerpt: Three retained sources support three sections and one focused company question. The September 15, 2026 brief keeps reported facts, company claims and your interpretation distinct.

documents.name: Product Launch
documents.summary: Milestones, blockers and the launch decisions still open.
documents.title: Launch Readiness
documents.excerpt: In this fictional website relaunch, the CMS decision blocks build work. The schedule exposes overlapping migration and build, while the decision about proceeding remains open.
headings: The CMS decision is the dependency to resolve first

documents.name: Sales Account
documents.summary: Discovery, requirements, meeting preparation and the proposal for one account.
documents.title: Account Brief
documents.excerpt: The fictional Meridian Retail opportunity has a useful next meeting: resolve export and Windows-review questions before sending a final proposal. The draft’s scope and exclusions remain visible.
headings: Resolve the handover questions before sending a final proposal

documents.name: Stock Portfolio
documents.summary: Holdings, quote coverage and concentration, refreshed from your own files.
documents.title: Portfolio Dashboard
documents.excerpt: Start with quote coverage and concentration in an illustrative holdings snapshot. The saved prices are dated, and the sample allocation is not a recommendation. Check source dates before making a decision.

documents.name: Supplier Review
documents.summary: Renewal offers, spending and the service terms left unresolved.
documents.title: Supplier Review
documents.excerpt: Three fictional renewals separate offered annual fees from variable purchases. Unresolved service terms stay beside prices; a lower offered fee is not a realized saving.
headings: See the movement within each relationship
The price question is only half the review
Variable purchases are a different measure

documents.name: Support Knowledge
documents.summary: Repeated questions, stale articles and proposed answers.
documents.title: Support Knowledge
documents.excerpt: Repeated questions and an article’s state determine a review queue for a fictional scheduling product. The proposed wording is authored sample content; the collecting job maintains the queue.
headings: A small library with a visible gap
Work the queue, not just the chart

documents.name: Tax Advisor
documents.summary: Tax-year inputs, a bounded estimate and questions for your preparer.
documents.title: Tax Advisor
documents.excerpt: A fictional federal-return review keeps entered figures beside missing evidence and preparer questions. Its dated refund estimate is not an approved return or a current refund claim.

documents.name: Team Status
documents.summary: Keep a team's progress, blockers and next steps together.
documents.title: Team Status
documents.excerpt: Four fictional update files feed a team table and confidence chart. Change the example confidence from 35 to 45: the row and bar change, while the blocker and approval decision remain unresolved.

documents.name: Travel Planner
documents.summary: Itinerary, reservations to check and a travel budget.
documents.title: Portugal Itinerary
documents.excerpt: A fictional ten-night Portugal plan keeps an itinerary, budget and a shortlist together. The Douro night remains open until transport and cancellation terms are checked; no stay is booked.
headings: Five stops, with one night left deliberately open
